question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

The _________ of the new legislation has sparked a heated debate among lawmakers.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Effect**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word "**effect**" means the result or consequence of something. (किसी बात का परिणाम)
 
• It is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank in the given sentence as it fits grammatically and contextually.
 
 
• **Example**: The effect of the new policy on the economy is yet to be seen.</em&g
